diagnosis.what_happened: Asterisks / stars (*) were found in non-correlation tables (e.g. Table 20-4 regression assumption table containing 'مدل ۱: خودآسیبی کلی (*خودآسیبی*)' and markdown italic remnants), and significance stars appeared where exact p-values are reported.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Applying markdown italic formatting inside table headers or allowing significance asterisks outside correlation matrices creates visual clutter and violates APA 7 / supervisor formatting rules.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: Significance asterisks (*, **, ***) are strictly restricted to correlation matrices (Tables 19-4, 21-4, 28-4, 35-4, 41-4). All other tables (demographics, descriptives, ANOVA, regression, assumptions, chi-square) must report exact p-values and contain ZERO asterisks on variable names, cells, or labels.
diagnosis.rationale_why: Correlation matrices lack dedicated p-value columns, necessitating asterisk notation. All other statistical tables provide exact p-values (e.g. p = ۰.۰۰۱), rendering asterisks redundant and unscholarly.

desired_behavior: Restrict asterisk usage in tables exclusively to correlation matrices; purge all asterisks from non-correlation table cells, headers, and notes.
generalization: Never output asterisks in tables unless the table is explicitly a correlation matrix without dedicated p-value columns.
